title: Move objects to a destination only when at that destination location
description: Use this when attempting to place an object onto a surface or container that is not in the current location.
content: The "move [object] to [destination]" action only succeeds when the agent is physically at the destination location. If the move action fails with "Nothing happens," first navigate to the destination, then perform the move action again.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some pan and put it in countertop.

title: Complete the task by moving the heated object to the destination
description: Use this after successfully heating an object and needing to place it at a target location.
content: Once the object is heated, navigate to the destination surface and use the move action to place the object there, confirming the task is complete.

source.task_query: Your task is to: heat some plate and put it in sidetable.

title: Verify object state and location before finalizing a task
description: Use this when a task requires an object to have a specific state, such as being hot or cold.
content: After heating or cooling an object, check that the action succeeded by examining the object or observing the action feedback. If the object was moved into a container before the state change, take it back out, apply the state-changing action while holding it, and then place it into the target container.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a hot apple in fridge.

title: Handle multiple identical target objects by carrying one at a time
description: Use this when a task requires moving multiple objects of the same type to a destination.
content: When you need to move multiple objects of the same type, you can only carry one at a time. If a take action fails repeatedly, check your inventory and consider placing the currently held object back before attempting to pick up another one.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two newspaper and put them in coffeetable.
